confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on secondary sources: a 2022 Numbeo-derived university page, a 2026 cappuccino average from a French cost-of-living site, and travel-blog meal ranges. Beer and cocktail figures are partly inferred, and wine uses local glass and carafe ranges. Cocktail is a bounded estimate from beer and craft-cocktail ranges, not a survey. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation (16 Oct 2026) comes from a third-party page reproducing the RBA table and was not verified on rba.gov.au. EUR amounts were converted to USD using the cross-rate implied by that same reproduction, so the FX date and source carry some uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Athens is priced as a mid-sized southern European capital with strong summer tourism demand. Restaurant and coffee levels are anchored to Numbeo-derived Athens figures updated for inflation. Accommodation is benchmarked to comparable Mediterranean capitals in peak July season, and the hostel and hotel tiers are estimated from that basis.
